name: exp15_matched_comparisons
purpose: Matched comparison of nDNA profiles and the logit-trajectory representation (Jung and Jung, ACL 2026) on checkpoint identification and related-checkpoint retrieval, with identical prompts, positions, readout, scaling, DTW and scoring; plus a test of the belief-field direction.

readout.lens: logit lens: final norm + output head on every hidden state; the final node is the model's own output logits
readout.nodes: embedding output + all block outputs (L+1 nodes, L steps)

squad.note: A and B use disjoint contexts

scoring.scaling: per profile and channel, min-max to [0.05, 1]
scoring.dtw: aligned mean squared cost, band 0.2 in relative depth
scoring.channel_grid: channels with a different node count are linearly interpolated onto the step grid of length
retrieval: per-query chance and expected MRR from candidate composition
scoring.uncertainty: bootstrap over queries (10000) and over families (cluster bootstrap); paired bootstrap of differences against the comparison reference; permutation p for the nearest-neighbour rate (shuffled family labels)

tests: split-half reliability: cosine between the projected field on even and odd prompts of the same task, against different tasks
task identification from field direction against task identification from field norm
within-family direction: cosine between base and instruct fields on the same task, against the split-half ceiling
target alignment: share of the positive mass of the final-node field on the task's 50 most frequent target tokens, against chance
exact against projected field: angle per node
